request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) expires Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. Before then:

- **Attend the appointment at the Ausländerbehörde** (Stadt Musterstadt) on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. Bring your original passport, current enrolment certificate for winter semester 2026/27, proof of financial means, proof of health insurance, a biometric photo, and your rental agreement or landlord confirmation (as listed in the invitation letter) [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp].
- **Pay the application fee of 100.00 €** on-site at that appointment, by girocard only — cash is not accepted [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- If you can't apply before the expiry date, note that your extension application must be filed before Mon 30 Nov 2026; otherwise your right to stay under the current permit does not automatically continue, per §81(4) S.1–2 AufenthG, with an exception for a Schengen visa — ask the office for a *Fiktionsbescheinigung* if needed [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

Also worth keeping in mind: your passport expires Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_g321eme013j2], and since a residence permit usually runs only as long as the passport, make sure your passport stays valid well beyond your permit's new term.
